89' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Kevin Muller has no trouble gathering it.
86' Chance! Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.

81' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.

75' The attendance for today's match is 57500.

71' 3 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Nathaniel Brown finds Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 3:0.
70' Substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya makes way for Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).

68' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Marnon Busch and he is replaced by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
68' The game has come to an end for Frans Kratzig. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
68' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
67' A cross by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

63' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Kaua Santos guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
61' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Can Yilmaz Uzun.
61' The substitution is prepared. Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rasmus Kristensen.
61' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
61' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
59' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
58' Sirlord Conteh rounds off a good move with a layoff to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
57' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
56' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
54' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.

46' Half-time substitution. Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is replaced by Sirlord Conteh.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Timo Gerach has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball is cleared after Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Hugo Ekitike tees up Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:0.
38' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
36' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
34' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
33' An attempted cross from Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) is cleared.
30' The main referee, Timo Gerach, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is given a yellow card for dissent.
30' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked for saying more than Timo Gerach was willing to tolerate.
29' Timo Gerach interrupts the game. One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Heidenheim win a free kick.
26' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
23' Half-chance! Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Kevin Muller reacts well to snuff out the attack.
22' Timo Gerach interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim). Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

20' What a poor attempt! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
19' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
18' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) sends a long ball in, but Kaua Santos comfortably gathers the ball.
16' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

16' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Kevin Muller thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
15' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a long through ball, but Kevin Muller deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
14' A spell of possession for Eintracht Frankfurt in an attempt to control the game.
13' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Fares Chaibi produces a great pass that finds Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
10' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
8' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) takes the corner with a short pass.
8' A header by Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Kaua Santos, who makes a brilliant save.
7' Heidenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
6' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
4' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
